subject.title: fix(zai): send user agent during endpoint detection

question: Should maintainers accept the missing live Z.AI Coding Plan smoke for this narrow source-level fix, or require a redacted live detection run before merge?
rationale: The contributor cannot provide a Z.AI Coding Plan key, and the code/test evidence is strong but does not show the real service accepting the after-fix probe.

options.title: Accept source-level proof
options.body: Merge after normal CI if maintainers accept the linked live before-fix evidence plus the focused header regression as enough for this credential-bound fix.

options.title: Require live smoke
options.body: Wait for a maintainer or contributor with a redacted Coding Plan key to post endpoint-detection output showing coding-global selection after the patch.

options.title: Choose another sibling PR
options.body: Use a sibling PR only if it has stronger real behavior proof and an equally narrow patch, then close this PR as superseded after that path is clearly canonical.

recommendation.title: Accept source-level proof
recommendation.body: Merge after normal CI if maintainers accept the linked live before-fix evidence plus the focused header regression as enough for this credential-bound fix.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and later maintained the Z.AI endpoint-detection and Coding Plan behavior most central to this proof-sufficiency choice.
